notes: Kakuzi PLC — Nairobi Securities Exchange (NSE) listed Kenyan plantation operator. ~12,300 ha (30,400 acres) planted across diversified tree crops in Murang'a + Makuyu, Kenya: avocado (Hass — global #2 grower at scale), macadamia, tea, blueberries, livestock, forestry, pineapple. Majority shareholder Camellia Plc (UK, ~50.7%). FY = calendar year. Reports in KES. FY history from Kakuzi annual reports / NSE filings via kakuzi.co.ke. Bookland reflects ~KES 2.4B biological assets + land carrying value (audited annual financial statements).

periods.notes: FY20: Revenue KES 2.74B (+9% YoY); PAT KES 460M. Strong avocado prices to Europe + COVID resilient demand. Net cash position.
FY21: Revenue KES 2.87B; PAT KES 410M. Avocado export pricing remained firm; macadamia volumes down on China demand softness.
FY22: Revenue KES 3.4B (+19%) record on avocado tonnage + China direct-export market opening. PAT KES 425M.
FY23: Revenue KES 1.57B (-54%) — global avocado oversupply (Peru/Mexico) crashed prices; macadamia weak. Net loss KES 340M — first loss in years; dividend suspended.
FY24: Revenue KES 2.38B (+52%) recovery; PAT KES 230M, dividend restored at KES 8/share. Avocado pricing partially normalised; blueberry expansion progressing.
